'''Energy''' is one of the resources of the [[Keeper]]. Almost all actions consume Energy, with working at a [[workstation]] being one of the main uses. Each action has its own Energy cost.

The maximum amount of Energy is 100, but this can be reduced by {{Item|Insanity}}. Energy can only be restored by eating food or sleeping. The Energy bar can be viewed at any time in the upper-left corner of the screen, next to the [[days]]. The exact current Energy value is not displayed.

== Lack of sleep ==
If the Keeper stays awake for more than two days, he gains the '''Lack of Sleep''' effect. While this effect is active, every point of Energy consumed adds 0.5 points of {{Item|Insanity}}. The effect is removed by sleeping
